entropy_projection.global_positive_metric: one diagonal conserved scale M shared by all cells
entropy_projection.proposal: same explicit midpoint RK2 conserved proposal
entropy_projection.root_property: derivative at theta=0 is -sum ||v_i-mean(v)||_M^2 < 0 unless the patch is uniform
entropy_projection.scalar_solve: find theta such that sum eta(U_i+theta z_i) equals the initial periodic entropy

ports.composition: source half, relaxed equilibrium transport full, source half

recovery.map: primitive -> compensated entropy point -> temporal currents
recovery.solver: scaled trust-region least squares seeded by the accepted old primitive
recovery.unknowns: log rho, log T, and two unconstrained rapidity coordinates

scalar_gamma_policy: withdrawn before binding execution; the nontrivial root is not guaranteed inside [0.8,1.2]

spatial_step.coefficient_policy: reanchor only after an accepted full split step
spatial_step.entropy_relaxation: conservative zero-sum entropy projection after the RK2 proposal
spatial_step.residual: conservative flux difference accumulated high and low separately

state.entropy: eta(v)=v dot U(v)-X^t(v), evaluated with compensated alpha and flux arithmetic
state.shear_height: five STF and two height-port coordinates advanced by the certified midpoint/Cayley split
